words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: I could hear my heartbeat after running.
words.ex_cn: 跑步后我听到了自己的心跳。
words.en: The regular movement or sound made by the heart as it pumps blood around the body.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: They live in a suburban neighborhood near the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在靠近城市的市郊社区。
words.en: Suburban means relating to a suburb, which is an area on the edge of a large town or city where people live. It often implies a residential area with a lower population density than the inner city.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He bought a brand-new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。
words.en: Completely new, as if recently made or acquired.

words.ex: He disconnects the cable from the TV.
words.ex_cn: 他把电缆从电视上拔掉。
words.en: To disconnect something means to separate it from something else to which it is attached or connected.

words.ex: He walked down the wide boulevard with many shops.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着满是商店的宽阔大马路散步。
words.en: A boulevard is a wide street in a city, usually with trees along the sides.

words.ex: He goes to kindergarten every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上幼儿园。
words.en: A kindergarten is a school or class for young children, usually between the ages of four and six.

words.ex: He tried to reconcile his work and family life.
words.ex_cn: 他试图调和工作与家庭生活。
words.en: If you reconcile two beliefs, facts, or demands that seem to be opposed or completely different, you find a way in which they can both be true or both be successful.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.tr: v. 连根拔起；迁离；根除；
words.ex: The storm uprooted the old tree.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把那棵老树连根拔起了。
words.en: If you uproot yourself or if you are uprooted, you leave a place where you have lived for a long time and go to live somewhere else.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.ex: The climbers found a foothold on the rocky wall.
words.ex_cn: 登山者在岩壁上找到了一个立足点。
words.en: A foothold is a secure position from which further progress or development may be made.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: The eventual winner was a young student.
words.ex_cn: 最后的赢家是一位年轻学生。
words.en: An eventual event or situation happens at the end of a process or period of time.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （数量、水平、兴趣等）逐渐减少，下降，消失
words.ex: The crowd started to drop away when it began to rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时人群开始散去了。
words.en: To gradually decrease or disappear.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 弥合差距；消除隔阂
words.ex: He works hard to bridge the gap between students and teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他努力弥合学生和老师之间的差距。
words.en: To reduce or eliminate the differences between two things or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 接受（现实、情况等）；与……达成协议；逐渐适应某事
words.ex: He came to terms with his failure.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了失败。
words.en: To accept or become resigned to something, especially something unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 日复一日；天天；持续不断地
words.ex: He works day in and day out to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地工作来养家糊口。
words.en: If something happens day in and day out, it happens every day without changing and is often boring.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The problem has too much complexity.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题太复杂了。
words.en: Complexity is the state of having many different parts connected or related to each other in a complicated way.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: He resisted the temptation to eat cake.
words.ex_cn: 他抵制了吃蛋糕的诱惑。
words.en: If you feel you want to do something or have something, even though you know you really should avoid it, you can refer to this feeling as temptation.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr: adj. 烦人的； v. “nag”的现在分词；
words.ex: The nagging sound of the alarm woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 烦人的闹钟声把我吵醒了。
words.en: If you describe someone as nagging, you mean that they keep asking or telling you to do something, in an annoying way.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He is dishonest when he lies about his homework.
words.ex_cn: 当他谎报作业时，他是不诚实的。
words.en: If you say that someone is dishonest, you mean that they are not honest and you cannot trust them.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: The sailor stood on the lookout for other ships.
words.ex_cn: 水手站在瞭望处观察其他船只。
words.en: A lookout is a person who watches for danger or for any sign of something that has been anticipated.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: The therapist helped him feel better after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 治疗专家在事故后帮助他感觉好些了。
words.en: A therapist is a person who is skilled in a particular type of therapy and treats people using it.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速把手伸进；溜进；一心投入
words.ex: He dove into the pocket to grab his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速把手伸进口袋去拿钥匙。
words.en: To start doing something suddenly and energetically, often without thinking about it first.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr: phrase. 与…出去玩；和…闲逛；与…混在一起
words.ex: I hang out with my friends after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后和朋友一起玩。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually in the company of someone.

words.tr: 习语. 不可否认；无法否认
words.ex: There's no denying he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 不可否认，他工作很努力。
words.en: It is impossible to deny that something is true.

words.tr: 习语. 不可否认某事；无法否认某事
words.ex: There's no denying he is good at math.
words.ex_cn: 不可否认，他很擅长数学。
words.en: It is impossible to deny that something is true.

words.tr: phrase. 不可否认的是；无可辩驳的是
words.ex: There's no denying that he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 毫无疑问，他工作很努力。
words.en: It is impossible to deny that; used to emphasize that something is definitely true.

words.tr: phrase. 徒劳地；免费地；一无所得
words.ex: He worked hard, but it was for nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作了，但却是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something was for nothing, you mean that it was not worth doing because you did not achieve anything by doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 失去联系；失去联络；不再了解
words.ex: We lost touch after I moved to another city.
words.ex_cn: 我搬到另一个城市后，我们就失去了联系。
words.en: To no longer communicate or be in contact with someone.

words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地对待…；严肃地看待…
words.ex: He takes his homework seriously.
words.ex_cn: 他认真对待他的作业。
words.en: To regard something as important and deserving of attention or concern.

words.ex: We drove along the parkway lined with trees.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着两旁种满树木的林荫大道开车。
words.en: A parkway is a wide road with areas of grass and trees on either side, often in a city, designed to be attractive and to provide a pleasant route for driving.

words.ex: He parked his car on the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车道上。
words.en: A driveway is a private road that leads from a public road to a house or other building.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The heat was inescapable in the small room.
words.ex_cn: 小房间里热得无法逃避。
words.en: If you describe a fact, situation, or activity as inescapable, you mean that it is difficult not to notice it or be affected by it.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.ex: He develops film in the darkroom.
words.ex_cn: 他在暗室里冲洗胶片。
words.en: A darkroom is a room from which normal light is excluded, used especially for developing photographs.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.ex: He had a daydream about winning the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个中彩票的白日梦。
words.en: A daydream is a series of pleasant thoughts about something you would like to happen, often about something that is unlikely to happen.

words.tr: n. 假小子，行为似男孩的顽皮姑娘
words.ex: She is a tomboy who loves playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 她是个喜欢踢足球的假小子。
words.en: A girl who enjoys rough, noisy activities traditionally associated with boys.

words.ex: The midwife helped the baby come out safely.
words.ex_cn: 助产士帮助婴儿安全出生。
words.en: A midwife is a person, usually a woman, who is trained to help women during childbirth.

words.tr: n. 流沙；陷阱；危险而捉摸不定的事物
words.ex: The boy got stuck in quicksand.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩陷在流沙里了。
words.en: Quicksand is an area of loose wet sand that you sink into if you walk on it.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: She put a red tablecloth on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上铺了一块红色的桌布。
words.en: A tablecloth is a cloth used to cover a table. Some are mainly ornamental coverings, which may also help protect the table from scratches and stains.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: He agreed verbally, not in writing.
words.ex_cn: 他口头同意了，但没有书面形式。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is expressed in speech, not in writing or action.

words.tr: adj. 疯狂的；精神失常的；精神错乱的
words.ex: He thinks it's insane to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 他认为无证驾驶是疯狂的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as insane, you mean that they are very foolish or crazy.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.tr: n. 精神失常；疯狂；极蠢
words.ex: His idea to jump from the roof was pure lunacy.
words.ex_cn: 他从屋顶跳下去的主意简直是疯了。
words.en: Lunacy is behavior that is stupid, dangerous, or insane.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: The child was fearful of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: If you are fearful of something, you are afraid of it.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 后退；退一步；退出（某事）
words.ex: He decided to step back and think clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他决定后退一步，冷静思考。
words.en: To move backwards, especially in order to avoid something or to consider something again from a different perspective.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: phrase. 大白天；光天化日之下
words.ex: He stole the bike in broad daylight.
words.ex_cn: 他在大白天偷了自行车。
words.en: The period of the day when the sun is up and it is light outside, typically used to emphasize that something is happening openly and in full view.

words.tr: phrase. 光天化日之下；在大白天
words.ex: The thief stole the bike in broad daylight.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在大白天偷了自行车。
words.en: If something happens in broad daylight, it happens during the day, when it is light and people can see it clearly.

words.ex: He has quite a lot of homework today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天有很多作业。
words.en: A considerable amount or number.

words.ex: He has quite a bit of homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有不少作业。
words.en: A considerable amount or degree; quite a lot.

words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 给（钟表等）上发条；使紧张；结束；最终导致
words.ex: He will wind up the clock every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都会给钟上发条。
words.en: To bring something to an end; to coil or twist something; to make someone nervous or excited.

words.ex: The dry grass burned up quickly in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 干草在阳光下迅速烧了起来。
words.en: If something burns up or if fire burns it up, it is completely destroyed by fire or heat.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使建筑物等）烧毁；烧成平地
words.ex: The old house burned down in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子在火灾中被烧毁了。
words.en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

words.tr: phrase. 减慢；放慢速度（尤指因障碍或困难）
words.ex: The car slowed up when it saw the red light.
words.ex_cn: 当车看到红灯时，它慢了下来。
words.en: To reduce speed or to cause something to reduce speed.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.tr: phrase. 自相矛盾；说话前后不一
words.ex: You said you were busy, but you just agreed to go to the party. You contradict yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你说你很忙，但你刚刚同意去参加派对。你自相矛盾了。
words.en: To say or do something that is the opposite of what you have said or done before.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.tr: adj. 无结果的；无成效的；
words.ex: The meeting was fruitless because no decisions were made.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议毫无结果，因为没有做出任何决定。
words.en: If an action or attempt to do something is fruitless, it is unsuccessful or produces nothing of value.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；功利主义的；
words.ex: The chair is utilitarian and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子实用又舒适。
words.en: Utilitarian means relating to or adhering to the belief that the value of a thing or an action is determined by its utility.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.tr: adj. 专注的；专用的；献身的； v. 奉献；“dedicate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is dedicated to his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于学习。
words.en: If you say that someone is dedicated to something, you approve of the fact that they have committed to it and are willing to give a lot of time and energy to it.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He uses a flashcard to learn new words.
words.ex_cn: 他用闪卡来学习新单词。
words.en: A flashcard is a card bearing information on both sides, which is intended to be used as an aid in memorization. Each flashcard bears a question on one side and an answer on the other. Flashcards are often used to memorize vocabulary, historical dates, formulas or any subject matter that can be learned via a question-and-answer format.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: She polished the silverware before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚餐前擦拭了银器。
words.en: Silverware refers to items made of silver, especially tableware such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: He walked up the stair to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯到了二楼。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.ex: I forgive you for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我原谅你迟到了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.tr: adj. 使人精疲力竭的； v. “exhaust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long hike was exhausting.
words.ex_cn: 这次长途徒步让人精疲力竭。
words.en: If you describe an activity or situation as exhausting, you mean that it makes you feel extremely tired.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: adj. 令人抑郁的；令人沮丧的；令人消沉的； v. “depress”的现在分词；
words.ex: The rainy weather made the day feel depressing.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨的天气让这一天感觉令人抑郁。
words.en: Making someone feel very unhappy and without hope.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.tr: adj. 确定的； v. 向…保证；“assure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was assured that the package would arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他确定包裹明天会到。
words.en: If you are assured of something, you are certain to get it or achieve it.

words.ex: The onus is on you to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 完成这个项目是你的职责。
words.en: The responsibility for something, especially a duty or task.

words.ex: He spoke respectfully to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他恭敬地对老师说话。
words.en: In a way that shows respect or deference.

words.ex: By and large, he is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他是个好学生。
words.en: You use 'by and large' to indicate that a statement is mostly but not completely true.

words.ex: He went out for all it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite; used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement in your sentence very surprising

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.tr: phrase. 太常；屡次发生地；不幸的是经常
words.ex: He misses the bus all too often.
words.ex_cn: 他经常错过公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something happens more often than it should, usually something bad.

words.tr: phrase. 放心；确信无疑；尽管放心
words.ex: Rest assured, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 放心吧，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: If you say that someone can rest assured that something is the case, you mean that it is definitely the case, so they do not need to worry about it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲荡；胡闹；不认真对待
words.ex: The boys are fooling around in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 那些男孩在教室里瞎闹。
words.en: To spend time doing things that are not useful or serious.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: I will do it for now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在先做它。
words.en: For now is used to indicate that a particular situation exists at the present time and may change in the future.

words.ex: The host showed great hospitality to the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主人对客人表现出极大的款待。
words.en: Hospitality is friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, especially by giving them food, drink, or a place to stay.

words.ex: The child squirmed in his chair.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在椅子上扭动着。
words.en: If you squirm, you move your body from side to side, usually because you are nervous or uncomfortable.

words.tr: n. 准确；精确；细节；细微的差别
words.ex: The nicety of the measurement surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个测量的准确性让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A nicety is a fine detail or distinction, especially one that is considered to be important or elegant.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.ex: We had a potluck dinner with neighbors last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们和邻居们吃了一顿家常便饭。
words.en: A potluck is a meal or party to which each of the guests contributes a dish.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.ex: It is customary to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是习惯做法。
words.en: Something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: They enjoy chit-chat during coffee breaks.
words.ex_cn: 他们在咖啡休息时喜欢闲聊。
words.en: Chit-chat is informal conversation about things that are not very important.

words.tr:
v. 窥探；刺探
n. 打探私事的人；私家侦探
words.ex: He tries to snoop in his neighbor's mailbox.
words.ex_cn: 他试图偷看邻居的邮箱。
words.en: To snoop means to look around a place secretly in order to discover things, especially things that someone does not want you to know.

words.tr: n. 新屋落成宴；乔迁庆宴
words.ex: They had a housewarming party last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末举办了乔迁派对。
words.en: A housewarming is a party that is held to celebrate moving into a new home.

words.tr: adj. 未事先通知的；未打招呼的
words.ex: The teacher gave an unannounced quiz.
words.ex_cn: 老师突然进行了一次小测验。
words.en: If someone arrives or does something unannounced, they do it without telling anyone beforehand.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: The climate is hospitable for growing oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这种气候适合种植橙子。
words.en: If someone is hospitable, they are friendly, welcoming, and generous to guests or strangers.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: She feels at home in her new apartment.
words.ex_cn: 她在新公寓里感觉像在家一样。
words.en: To feel comfortable and relaxed in a place or with a person, as if you were in your own home.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.tr: phrase. phr. （因逗留太久或行为不当）使别人不再欢迎自己；待得太久惹人厌
words.ex: If you stay too long, you might wear out your welcome.
words.ex_cn: 如果你待得太久，可能会让人厌烦。
words.en: To stay as a guest longer than one is wanted.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: phrase. 经验法则；粗略估计；拇指规则（指基于经验的粗略判断而非精确计算）
words.ex: He uses the rule of thumb to estimate the cost.
words.ex_cn: 他用经验法则来估算成本。
words.en: A rule of thumb is a principle with broad application that is not intended to be strictly accurate or reliable for every situation.

words.tr: 短语. 连续多天；一次持续数天
words.ex: He sleeps for days at a time when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会连续睡好几天。
words.en: For a period of several days continuously.

words.tr: 短语，连续数周地；一次持续数周
words.ex: He works for weeks at a time without taking a break.
words.ex_cn: 他连续几周工作而不休息。
words.en: For a period of several weeks continuously.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 热烈欢迎某人；张开双臂欢迎某人
words.ex: They welcomed her with open arms after she returned home.
words.ex_cn: 她回家后，他们热情地欢迎了她。
words.en: To greet someone enthusiastically or warmly.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 热烈欢迎某事；张开双臂迎接某事
words.ex: They welcomed the new student with open arms.
words.ex_cn: 他们热情地欢迎了这位新生。
words.en: Receive someone or something with great enthusiasm and pleasure.

words.tr: phrase. 热烈欢迎某人；张开双臂迎接某人
words.ex: They greeted him with open arms after he came home.
words.ex_cn: 他回家后，他们热情地欢迎了他。
words.en: To welcome someone very warmly and enthusiastically.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: She wore a parisian style hat.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶巴黎风格的帽子。
words.en: Of or relating to Paris or its inhabitants.

words.tr:
adj. 中途的；中间的
adv. 中途地；中间地
n. 娱乐场；游乐场
words.ex: He stopped midway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他中途停下来休息。
words.en: Midway is used to describe something that is in the middle of a place or a period of time.

words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激起了他的好奇心。
words.en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr:
adj. 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的；
n. 意大利语；意大利人；
words.ex: She loves italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢意大利食物。
words.en: Of or relating to Italy, its people, or its language.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.tr: v. （使）迷惑；“puzzle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 困惑的；
words.ex: He was puzzled by the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个简单的问题弄糊涂了。
words.en: If you are puzzled, you are confused because you do not understand something.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.ex: He bought a cigarette at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一支香烟。
words.en: A cigarette is a small roll of finely cut tobacco for smoking, enclosed in a wrapper of thin paper.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: phrase. 浴袍；晨衣（指在家穿着的宽松长袍）
words.ex: He put on his dressing gown after waking up.
words.ex_cn: 他醒来后穿上了他的晨袍。
words.en: A dressing gown is a long, loose robe which you wear over your night clothes when you are not in bed.

words.tr: 短语. 遍及…的每个角落；整个…范围
words.ex: He walked the length and breadth of the park.
words.ex_cn: 他走遍了公园的每个角落。
words.en: The entire area or all parts of a place.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 后退；退却；回避
words.ex: He sees a bear and back away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他看到一只熊，慢慢后退。
words.en: To move backwards away from something or someone, usually because you are frightened or unsure.

words.tr: phrase. 提及某人；谈到某人；向某人查询；让某人去参考
words.ex_cn: 他向老师求助。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 提到；涉及；指的是；参考；查阅
words.ex: He refers to the book when he writes.
words.ex_cn: 他写作时参考这本书。
words.en: To mention or allude to something, especially in writing or speech.

words.w: reserve the right to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 保留做某事的权利；保留采取某行动的权利
words.uk: rɪˈzɜːv ðə raɪt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: rɪˈzɜːrv ðə raɪt tə du ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The company reserves the right to change the rules.
words.ex_cn: 公司保留更改规则的权利。
words.en: To keep the option or possibility to do something in the future, often as a way of maintaining control or flexibility in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事感到厌倦；厌烦某事物
words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To become bored or weary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事感到厌倦或疲惫
words.ex: He grows tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To become bored or weary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对做某事感到厌倦
words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To become bored or lose interest in doing something because it has been done too often or for too long.

words.tr: phrase. 对做某事感到厌倦或疲惫
words.ex: He grows tired of doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To become bored or weary of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 转身并做某事（常用于表示突然改变态度或行为）
words.ex_cn: 他转过身，走开了。
words.en: To change direction and perform a specific action.

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.tr: n. 思想结晶；脑力成果
words.ex: The new app is his brainchild.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用是他想出来的主意。
words.en: An idea or invention that is the result of one's creative thinking.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr: n. 建立人际关系网；网络化；
words.ex: He went to the party for networking.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加聚会是为了建立人际关系网。
words.en: The process of interacting with others to exchange information and develop professional or social contacts.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The company sells its products globally.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在全球范围内销售其产品。
words.en: In a way that relates to the whole world; worldwide.

words.tr: n. 寻求者；追求者；搜索者
words.ex: The seeker found a hidden path in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位寻找者在森林里发现了一条隐蔽的小路。
words.en: Someone who is trying to find or obtain something.

words.tr: n. 提供者；供应者；供养人；
words.ex: The hospital is a health care provider.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家医疗服务提供者。
words.en: A provider is a person or organization that supplies or makes available something that is needed or wanted.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: He buys books on e-commerce websites.
words.ex_cn: 他在电子商务网站上买书。
words.en: the buying and selling of goods and services on the Internet

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: He touched the button with his fingertip.
words.ex_cn: 他用指尖按了按钮。
words.en: The very end of a finger.

words.tr: phrase. 开始现场直播；上线运行；正式启动（项目或系统）
words.ex: The show will go live at 8 PM.
words.ex_cn: 这个节目将在晚上8点直播。
words.en: To become operational or to start broadcasting in real time, especially on the internet or television.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: phrase. 被限制在某事物范围内；仅限于某事物
words.ex: His knowledge is limited to basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识仅限于基础数学。
words.en: To be restricted or confined to a particular thing or area.

words.tr: 短语. 垂手可得；近在咫尺；随时可用（指信息、资源等）
words.ex: The information is at your fingertips.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息就在你的指尖。
words.en: Having information or resources easily accessible or readily available.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: She bought new resort-wear for her beach vacation.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的海滩假期买了新的度假装。
words.en: Clothing designed for wear on vacation, especially in a resort setting, typically lightweight and suitable for warm weather.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: The retailer sells clothes to customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家零售商向顾客出售衣服。
words.en: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr: v. 置于某物之上；添加
words.ex: He superimposes a map on the photo.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图叠加在照片上。
words.en: To superimpose something means to place or lay one thing over another, typically so that both are still evident.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: He scans the barcode with a small machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小机器扫描条形码。
words.en: A bar code is a pattern of thick and thin black lines that is printed on things you buy. It contains information that a computer can read.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.ex: The boss gave a thumbs-down to the lazy employee.
words.ex_cn: 老板对那个懒惰的员工提出了责备。
words.en: A thumbs-down is a gesture or expression of disapproval or rejection.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.tr: adj. 与真人或实物一样大小的
words.ex: The artist created a life-size portrait of the queen.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家创作了一幅与女王真人一样大小的肖像。
words.en: A life-size model or picture is the same size as the person or thing that it represents.

words.tr: adj. 有极大诱惑力的；不可抵抗的；
words.ex: The chocolate cake looked irresistible.
words.ex_cn: 那块巧克力蛋糕看起来极具诱惑力。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

words.tr: adj. 清凉的，适合夏季穿的
words.ex: He wears summer-weight clothes in July.
words.ex_cn: 他在七月穿轻薄的夏装。
words.en: Designed to be light and suitable for wear in summer.

words.ex: The child told a fanciful story about flying dragons.
words.ex_cn: 孩子讲了一个关于会飞的龙的富于幻想的故事。
words.en: If you describe an idea as fanciful, you mean that it is imaginative rather than reasonable or practical.

words.ex: The government increased transparency about its decisions.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了决策的透明度。
words.en: The condition of being transparent, especially in a way that allows easy understanding or recognition of something.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: He buys gasoline for his car every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周为他的汽车买汽油。
words.en: Gasoline is a volatile, flammable liquid obtained from petroleum and used as fuel in internal combustion engines.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: phrase. 折扣商店；廉价商店
words.ex: I bought shoes at a discount store.
words.ex_cn: 我在折扣店买了鞋子。
words.en: A discount store is a retail establishment which sells products at prices lower than the usual market price.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He uses cloud computing to store his files.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云计算来存储文件。
words.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of different services through the Internet, including data storage, servers, databases, networking, and software.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.ex: The teacher called the students by name.
words.ex_cn: 老师按名字叫学生。
words.en: By name means to refer to someone or something using their name.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrase. 很多的；丰富的；大量的
words.ex: He has a wealth of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: A large amount of something valuable or useful.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.ex: Small wonder he was exhausted after working all night.
words.ex_cn: 他通宵工作后感到筋疲力尽，这不足为奇。
words.en: It is not surprising that something has happened.

words.ex: Little wonder he was tired after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天，难怪他会累。
words.en: It is not surprising or unexpected, given the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 难怪；不足为奇；并不奇怪
words.ex: It's no wonder he passed the test; he studied all night.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，这并不奇怪，因为他整晚都在学习。
words.en: It is not surprising that something has happened or is true.

words.ex: It's small wonder he passed the test—he studied all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他通过了考试，他整晚都在学习。
words.en: It is not surprising; it is to be expected given the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 难怪；不足为奇；并不奇怪
words.ex: It's little wonder he passed the test—he studied all night.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，这并不奇怪——他整晚都在学习。
words.en: It is not surprising; it is expected given the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 涌入市场；大量投放商品导致市场饱和
words.ex: The company flooded the market with cheap phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向市场大量投放廉价手机。
words.en: To release a large quantity of a product into the market, often leading to a decrease in price due to oversupply.

words.tr: vt. 解冻；解除对……的控制；融化
words.ex: She will unfreeze the meat tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天会解冻那块肉。
words.en: To unfreeze something means to cause it to stop being frozen, or to allow it to be used or dealt with again after it has been frozen or blocked.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr:
adj. 专横的；爱发号施令的
n. 母牛或小牛
words.ex: She is bossy and tells others what to do.
words.ex_cn: 她很专横，总是告诉别人该做什么。
words.en: If you describe someone as bossy, you mean that they enjoy telling people what to do.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的； 心情焦躁的；易怒的
words.ex: He gets uptight when people are late.
words.ex_cn: 当别人迟到时，他会变得紧张。
words.en: If you say that someone is uptight, you mean that they are very tense, nervous, or angry about something.

words.ex: He obsesses over small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他 obsesses 于微小的错误。
words.en: If something or someone obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: The coronation ceremony was a grand event.
words.ex_cn: 加冕典礼是一个盛大的活动。
words.en: A coronation is a ceremony in which a king or queen is officially crowned.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.tr:
n. 抒情诗；歌词
adj. 抒情的
words.ex: He wrote a lyric about the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于日落的抒情诗。
words.en: Lyric refers to the words of a song, especially a popular song, or to a short poem that expresses personal feelings and thoughts.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: She is a lovable and kind-hearted person.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个可爱且心地善良的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as lovable, you mean that they have attractive qualities, and are easy to like.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.tr: adj. 迷人的；娇媚的； v. “charm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The little village is charming with its flowers and quiet streets.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄以其花朵和宁静的街道而迷人。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as charming, you mean they are very pleasant and attractive.

words.ex: Her infatuation with the movie star lasted only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 她对那位电影明星的迷恋只持续了几个星期。
words.en: An infatuation is an intense but short-lived passion or admiration for someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.tr: phrase. 跨过；忽视；不予理会
words.ex: He passed over the small stream on the log.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上跨过了那条小溪。
words.en: To ignore or disregard someone or something; to move across or beyond something.

words.tr: phrase. 失控的；无法控制的；失去控制的
words.ex: The car was out of control on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的路面上失去了控制。
words.en: If something is out of control, no one has any power over it.

words.tr: phrase. 联合；联手；合作；协力
words.ex: They join forces to clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们联合起来清理公园。
words.en: To join forces means to collaborate or work together with others towards a common goal.

words.ex: He found a way out of the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了走出黑暗房间的路。
words.en: A way out is a means of escape or exit from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 放手；不再抓住某物；放弃；不再计较
words.ex: He decided to let the old toy go.
words.ex_cn: 他决定把旧玩具扔掉。
words.en: To stop holding or controlling something or someone; to allow someone or something to be free.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.ex: After he practiced hard, everything fell into place.
words.ex_cn: 在他努力练习之后，一切顺利解决了。
words.en: If things fall into place, they happen in a satisfactory way, without problems.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐疏远；关系变得不亲密
words.ex: They grow apart because they have different interests.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为有不同的兴趣而渐渐疏远了。
words.en: If people who were close grow apart, they gradually start to have different interests and opinions from each other, and their relationship becomes less strong.

words.ex: She decided to run away from her problems instead of facing them.
words.ex_cn: 她决定逃离问题，而不是面对它们。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly in order to escape from something or someone.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
