words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.tr: adj. 非常兴奋的；极为激动的； v. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was thrilled when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他非常兴奋。
words.en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr: n. 重量级选手；体重超过平均水平的人；有影响力的人或事
words.ex: He is a heavyweight boxer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名重量级拳击手。
words.en: A heavyweight is a person or thing that is of great importance or influence, especially in a particular field or area.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The pilot flew a fighter jet over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员驾驶一架战斗机飞越了山脉。
words.en: A fighter is someone who fights in a battle or war, or someone who is determined to achieve something despite difficulties.

words.ex: He misguidedly trusted the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地信任了那个陌生人。
words.en: In a way that is based on or resulting from a wrong understanding or judgment.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: The new movie was a blockbuster and sold out every show.
words.ex_cn: 这部新电影大受欢迎，场场爆满。
words.en: A blockbuster is a film or book that is very popular and successful, especially one that has made a lot of money.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.tr: adj. 狂怒的；暴怒的；激烈的
words.ex: He was furious when he lost his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙时非常生气。
words.en: If someone is furious, they are extremely angry.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: The little girl drew a mermaid in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩画了一条海里的美人鱼。
words.en: A mermaid is a mythical sea creature with the head and upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish.

words.tr: n. 常看电影的人；电影迷
words.ex: The cinemagoer loves watching movies on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这个电影爱好者喜欢在周末看电影。
words.en: A person who regularly goes to the cinema to watch films.

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.tr: n. 摄影师；照相师；摄影记者
words.ex: The cameraman filmed the wedding yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师昨天拍摄了婚礼。
words.en: A cameraman is a person whose job is to operate a camera for television or film making.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: He played soccer for a time, then quit.
words.ex_cn: 他踢了一段时间足球，然后不踢了。
words.en: For a period of time.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 按某人的规矩行事；遵守某人的规则；服从某人的安排
words.ex: He won't play by his boss's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意按照老板的规矩来。
words.en: To act according to the rules set by someone else.

words.ex: He felt disappointment when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试没及格时，他感到失望。
words.en: A feeling of sadness or displeasure caused by the nonfulfillment of one's hopes or expectations.

words.ex: The correspondent reported the news from the city.
words.ex_cn: 记者从城市报道了新闻。
words.en: A correspondent is someone who reports news from a particular place or on a particular subject for a newspaper, magazine, or television or radio station.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr: n. 复出；重返；再度受欢迎；
words.ex: His comeback after injury surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他伤愈复出令所有人惊讶。
words.en: A comeback is a return by a well-known person, especially an entertainer or sports player, to the activity in which they have formerly been successful.

words.tr:
n. 枢；中心；旋转
v. 在枢轴上转动；以…为中心
words.ex: The door pivots on a hinge.
words.ex_cn: 门围绕一个铰链旋转。
words.en: A pivot is the central point, pin, or shaft on which a mechanism turns or oscillates. It can also refer to the central or most important person or thing in a situation.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: The electric lamp lights up the room.
words.ex_cn: 电灯照亮了房间。
words.en: Something that is electric works by means of electricity, is powered by electricity, or produces electricity.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: He plays music on an old phonograph.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧的留声机播放音乐。
words.en: A phonograph is a device that reproduces sound from records.

words.tr: phrase. 电影；影片；电影制作业
words.ex: He watches a motion picture every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末看一部电影。
words.en: A motion picture is a film that tells a story and is shown in cinemas or on television.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.ex: He is an innovator who created a new app.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创造了新应用程序的创新者。
words.en: An innovator is someone who introduces changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: He is an optimist who believes things will get better.
words.ex_cn: 他是个乐观主义者，相信事情会好转。
words.en: An optimist is someone who always expects good things to happen or is always hopeful about the future.

words.ex: The hard chair caused him discomfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把硬椅子让他感到不舒适。
words.en: Discomfort is a feeling of slight pain or physical unease, or a feeling of worry or embarrassment.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He was emotionally hurt by her words.
words.ex_cn: 他感情上被她的话伤害了。
words.en: In a way that relates to emotions or feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有共同之处；有共同点
words.ex: They have something in common because they both enjoy hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同点，因为他们都喜欢徒步旅行。
words.en: To share similar interests, characteristics, or experiences with someone else.

words.w: have sth. in common with sb.
words.tr: 短语. 与某人在某方面有共同之处
words.uk: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɒmən wɪð ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɑːmən wɪð ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: I have a lot in common with my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥有很多共同点。
words.en: to share interests, experiences, or other characteristics with someone

words.tr: phrase. 超越；克服；不受…影响；凌驾于…之上
words.ex: He rose above his fears and spoke in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了恐惧，当众发言。
words.en: To rise above something means to not allow yourself to be affected or limited by it, and to deal with it in a successful way.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 有史以来；空前；历来
words.ex: He is the best player of all time.
words.ex_cn: 他是有史以来最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize that someone or something is the best or most important of their kind in history.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 出错； 发生故障；误入歧途
words.ex: Things can go wrong if you don't follow the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照说明做，事情可能会出错。
words.en: If a situation or event goes wrong, it does not happen in the way you intended or expected, and often has a bad result.

words.ex: The nation celebrated its independence day.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家庆祝了它的独立日。
words.en: A nation is a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture, and history, who live in a particular area under one government.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.tr: v. （使）无法理解；（因吃惊）犹豫不决
words.ex: The math problem boggles my mind.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题让我困惑不已。
words.en: If you boggle at something, you are astonished or overwhelmed by it, often because it is very complicated or large.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.tr:
n. 尖塔；尖顶；尖峰；尖岩石；顶点；顶峰
v. 造小尖塔；把...放在极高处
words.ex: The pinnacle of the church reached high into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的尖塔高耸入云。
words.en: The pinnacle of something is the highest point or level that it can reach, especially when it is very good.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: Algebra is a foundational subject in math.
words.ex_cn: 代数是数学中的基础学科。
words.en: Relating to the foundation or basis of something; basic.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.ex: Someday, I will visit Paris.
words.ex_cn: 有朝一日，我会去巴黎。
words.en: At some time in the future.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.ex: Lastly, don't forget to lock the door.
words.ex_cn: 最后，别忘了锁门。
words.en: You use lastly when you are saying what happens after everything else in a series of actions or events.

words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: He persevered despite many failures.
words.ex_cn: 尽管多次失败，他仍然坚持不懈。
words.en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.ex: He feels fulfillment when he helps others.
words.ex_cn: 当他帮助别人时，他感到满足。
words.en: Fulfillment is the feeling of being happy and satisfied because you are doing something useful or important, or because you have achieved something.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: phrase. 放下武器；投降；停止战斗
words.ex: The soldiers agreed to lay down arms and stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们同意放下武器，停止战斗。
words.en: To cease fighting and surrender weapons, often used in the context of ending a conflict or war.

words.tr: phrase. 放下武器；投降；停止战斗
words.ex: The soldiers decided to lay down their arms and surrender.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们决定放下武器投降。
words.en: To lay down your arms means to stop fighting and surrender your weapons.

words.tr: 短语动词。下定决心做某事；专心致志于某事
words.ex: If you set your mind to it, you can accomplish anything.
words.ex_cn: 如果你下定决心，你就能完成任何事情。
words.en: If you set your mind to something, you are determined to do it and you put a lot of effort into achieving it.

words.tr: phrase. 专心致志于某事；下定决心做某事；把注意力集中在某事上
words.ex: If you put your mind to it, you can achieve anything.
words.ex_cn: 如果你专心去做，你可以成就任何事。
words.en: If you put your mind to something, you are determined to do it and you give it your full attention.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.ex: He wants to cut back on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 减少；削减（开支、用量等）
words.ex: We need to cut back on our expenses.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少开支。
words.en: To reduce the amount of something, especially in order to save money.

words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.w: be well on the way to sth.
words.tr: 短语. 已经大有进展；正在顺利地接近（某事）
words.uk: biː wel ɒn ðə weɪ tuː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: bi wɛl ɑn ðə weɪ tu sʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She is well on the way to becoming a professional dancer.
words.ex_cn: 她正在顺利地成为一名职业舞者。
words.en: If you are well on the way to doing something, you have made considerable progress towards it and are likely to achieve it.

words.w: be well on your way to sth.
words.tr: 短语. 已经在通往某事的成功或实现的道路上；离实现某事已经不远了
words.uk: biː wel ɒn jɔː weɪ tə ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: bi wel ɑːn jʊr weɪ tə ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: If you keep practicing, you'll be well on your way to mastering the piano.
words.ex_cn: 如果你继续练习，你将很快在掌握钢琴的道路上取得很大进展。
words.en: To be making good progress towards achieving something.

words.w: be well on the way to doing sth.
words.tr: 短语. 很有希望完成某事；已在很大程度上接近实现某事
words.uk: biː wel ɒn ðə weɪ tuː ˈduːɪŋ sʌmθɪŋ
words.us: biː wɛl ɑːn ðə weɪ tuː ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: After a year of hard work, she is well on the way to achieving her goal.
words.ex_cn: 经过一年的努力工作，她即将实现她的目标。
words.en: If you are well on the way to doing something, you have made considerable progress towards it and are likely to achieve it.

words.w: be well on your way to doing sth.
words.tr: 短语. 已经很好地踏上了做某事的征程；接近于完成某事；在实现某目标的过程中进展顺利
words.uk: biː wel ɒn jɔː weɪ tə ˈduːɪŋ sʌmθɪŋ
words.us: bi wɛl ɑn jʊr weɪ tə ˈduɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: After months of hard work, she is well on her way to completing her dissertation.
words.ex_cn: 经过数月的努力工作，她即将完成她的论文。
words.en: To be making good progress towards achieving something.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: He is learning artificial intelligence at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习人工智能。
words.en: Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: I trusted my intuition and chose the right answer.
words.ex_cn: 我相信自己的直觉，选了正确的答案。
words.en: Intuition is the ability to understand or know something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.tr: adj. 着迷的；被吸引住的； v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；“fascinate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were fascinated by the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对魔术表演着迷了。
words.en: If you are fascinated by something, it attracts and interests you greatly.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；叹息
n. 呻吟声；叹息声
words.ex: He groaned when he saw the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那个沉重的箱子时呻吟了一声。
words.en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

words.ex: Verily, I say unto you, this is a wise decision.
words.ex_cn: 我郑重地告诉你们，这是一个明智的决定。
words.en: Used to emphasize the truth of a statement; truly or certainly.

words.ex: The news saddened her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她感到悲伤。
words.en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

words.ex: The children sang merrily in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里欢快地唱歌。
words.en: If you say that someone does something merrily, you mean that they do it in a cheerful and carefree way.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: The baby's neural connections are developing fast.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的神经连接正在迅速发展。
words.en: Neural relates to a nerve or the nervous system.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: You are supposed to finish your homework before you go out to play.
words.ex_cn: 你应该在出去玩之前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 应该是某物；被认为或被期望是某种状态或身份
words.ex: This is supposed to be the best restaurant in town.
words.ex_cn: 这被认为是镇上最好的餐厅。
words.en: If you say that something is supposed to be the case, you mean that people say it is the case or that it is believed to be the case.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 有助于；促成；贡献于某事物
words.ex: The research contributes to our understanding of the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究有助于我们理解这种疾病。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: 短语. 别误会我的意思；请不要理解错我的意图
words.ex: Don't get me wrong, I appreciate your help, but I think we need to approach this problem differently.
words.ex_cn: 别误会我的意思，我感谢你的帮助，但我认为我们需要用不同的方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: used to tell someone that you do not mean to criticize them or that you want them to understand your true intentions

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 期待某事；盼望某事
words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 爱上某人；坠入爱河
words.ex: They fall in love at school.
words.ex_cn: 他们在学校里相爱了。
words.en: To begin to feel love or a very strong liking for someone.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: The company uses new tech to improve its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用新技术来改进其产品。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.tr: n．直播：通过互联网实时传输音频和视频的技术。
words.ex: The company uses live-streaming to reach a global audience.
words.ex_cn: 该公司使用直播来接触全球观众。
words.en: The broadcasting of live video or audio over the internet.

words.tr: v. 使通俗化；宣传；推广；使普及
words.ex: He wants to popularize science among children.
words.ex_cn: 他想在儿童中普及科学。
words.en: To make something known or liked by many people.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: The farmer used a drone to check his crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民用无人驾驶飞机检查他的庄稼。
words.en: A drone is a male bee that does not work and exists solely to mate with the queen bee. It can also refer to an unmanned aircraft or ship guided by remote control or onboard computers. Additionally, 'drone' can describe a continuous low humming sound or to speak in a monotonous tone.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.tr: adj. 快的；迅速的；敏捷的；
words.ex: He gave a speedy reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题做出了快速的答复。
words.en: Something that is speedy moves or happens quickly.

words.ex: They communicated using walkie-talkies during the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他们在徒步旅行中使用步话机进行通讯。
words.en: A walkie-talkie is a small portable radio which you can talk into and hear messages through so that you can communicate with someone far away.

words.tr: phrase. 数字钱包；电子钱包，用于存储支付信息并进行电子支付的系统或设备
words.ex: Using a digital wallet, you can make payments quickly and securely.
words.ex_cn: 使用数字钱包，您可以快速安全地进行支付。
words.en: A digital wallet is a system that securely stores users' payment information and passwords for numerous payment methods and websites. By using a digital wallet, users can complete purchases easily and quickly with near-field communications technology.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.ex: He runs fast and pulls ahead of the other boys.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，超过了其他男孩。
words.en: To move in front of someone or something in a race or competition.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.ex: He points to the door when he wants to leave.
words.ex_cn: 当他想离开时，他指向门。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something as being likely or true.

words.tr: phrase. 利用某物；使用某物；发挥某物的作用
words.ex: We should make use of every opportunity to learn.
words.ex_cn: v. 我们应该利用每一个学习的机会。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The town uses hydropower to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇用水力发电来产生电力。
words.en: Hydropower is the power generated by the force of moving water, used as a source of electricity.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The plant's roots help in the absorption of water.
words.ex_cn: 植物的根有助于水分的吸收。
words.en: The process by which one thing absorbs or is absorbed by another.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 风力涡轮机；风力发电机
words.ex: The wind turbine generates electricity from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机利用风力发电。
words.en: A wind turbine is a device that converts the kinetic energy of wind into electrical energy.

words.ex: The house has a solar panel on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的屋顶上有一个太阳能电池板。
words.en: A solar panel is a device that converts light from the sun into electricity.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: He is prone to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If you are prone to a particular problem or characteristic, you are likely to be affected by it or to have it.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr: adj. 可更新的；可再生的；
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可更新的资源。
words.en: A renewable resource is a natural resource which will replenish to replace the portion depleted by usage and consumption, either through natural reproduction or other recurring processes in a finite amount of time in a human time scale.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: First and foremost, we need to finish our homework.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要完成作业。
words.en: You use first and foremost to emphasize the most important quality or aspect of something.

words.ex: Needless to say, he was late again.
words.ex_cn: 不用说，他又迟到了。
words.en: used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；在一定范围内
words.ex: He understands the idea to a certain degree.
words.ex_cn: 他在一定程度上理解这个想法。
words.en: To some extent; not completely but somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 不言而喻；不用说；理所当然
words.ex: It goes without saying that education is important.
words.ex_cn: 教育的重要性不言而喻。
words.en: If you say that something goes without saying, you mean that it is obviously true and does not need to be said.

words.tr: phrase. 不言而喻；不用说；显而易见
words.ex: It goes without saying that we are delighted with the result.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 不言而喻，我们对结果感到高兴。
words.en: used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be stated

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: The milky way is bright in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 银河在夜空中很明亮。
words.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System, with the name describing the galaxy's appearance from Earth: a hazy band of light seen in the night sky formed from stars that cannot be individually distinguished by the naked eye.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.ex: The sun brightens the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早上使房间变亮。
words.en: To make something lighter or more colorful, or to make someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.tr:
v. 非法侵入；侵扰；冒犯
n. 非法进入；冒犯
words.ex: He trespasses on private land.
words.ex_cn: 他擅自进入私人土地。
words.en: To trespass is to enter someone's land or property without their permission.

words.tr:
n. 杂乱；混乱
v. 弄乱
words.ex: The table is full of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上堆满了杂物。
words.en: If things or people clutter a place, they fill it in an untidy way.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.ex: The medicine has a side effect of dizziness.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有头晕的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or chemical that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: The streetlight is on at night.
words.ex_cn: 路灯在晚上是亮着的。
words.en: A streetlight is a light on a tall post in the street, which provides light so that people can see when it is dark.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.ex: The old machine is inefficient and uses too much energy.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器效率低，耗能太多。
words.en: If someone or something is inefficient, they do not use time, energy, or resources in the best way.

words.ex: He answered the question improperly.
words.ex_cn: 他不正确地回答了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is not in accordance with accepted standards or rules.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adj. 开创性的；突破性的；
words.ex: This is a groundbreaking discovery in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这是医学领域的一项开创性发现。
words.en: If something is groundbreaking, it is very new and a big change from other things of its type.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: The lamp provides illumination in the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯为黑暗的房间提供照明。
words.en: The act of providing or casting light on something, or the state of being lit up; also, the clarification or elucidation of a subject or issue.

words.tr: v. 制服；压倒；令人折服；使难以忍受
words.ex: The police officer overpowered the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察制服了小偷。
words.en: If you overpower someone, you defeat them because you are stronger than they are.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: Love is an intangible thing.
words.ex_cn: 爱是一种无形的东西。
words.en: Something that is intangible is not able to be touched or seen, but is still important or valuable.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.ex: The weight of the box is measurable.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是可以测量的。
words.en: If something is measurable, it can be measured or quantified.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.ex: The homeowner fixed the roof himself.
words.ex_cn: 房主自己修了屋顶。
words.en: A homeowner is a person who owns the house or apartment they live in.

words.ex: He volunteers for civic projects in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他为家乡的市民项目做志愿者。
words.en: Relating to a city or town, especially its administration; relating to the duties or activities of people in relation to their town, city, or local area.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 某物的主体部分；某事物的主要组成部分
words.ex: He completed a full body of work in just one year.
words.ex_cn: 他在短短一年内完成了一整套作品。
words.en: The main or central part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.
